name: Jattashankar Industries Limited
about: Jattashankar Industries Limited manufactures and sells polyester dyed, high bulk, cotton dyed, and other fancy dyed yarns in India. The company offers yarns for use in suitings, shirtings, sarees, and dress materials; hosieries and knitwear; furnishing and upholstery fabrics; labels, laces, tapes, and elastics; sewing threads; curtains and elastic tapes; and industrial fabrics. It also provides woven elastic tapes; and processes polyesters yarns. The company was formerly known as Jatta Poly Yarn Private Limited and changed its name to Jattashankar Industries Limited in April 2002. Jattashankar Industries Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
